species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 50°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–20 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 50°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 10–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
